section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses demographic effects on women's body image, specifically focusing on age and socioeconomic status (SES). It reviews existing literature on how age affects body image and BMI, noting equivocal results, and touches upon the limited research on SES and body image among Western women, with mixed findings. The section concludes by stating that the 'present study' included educational status as a proxy for SES, indicating a single study.
